sword: Swordsman ultimate 'Ten-Thousand-and-First Slash': a calm pause, then one perfect wide horizontal silver-white sword slash cuts clean through the enemy, a thin bright line lingers, then the air splits with a delayed shockwave burst, white sparks and wind streaks.
blond: Holy sword ultimate 'Twin Moon Judgment': golden light gathers into two giant gold and white crescent blades that cross in a huge X through the enemy, a pillar of holy light slams down, a golden shockwave ring expands, golden feathers and star sparkles rain down.
witch: Witch ultimate 'Thirteenth Spell': a huge glowing purple hexagram magic circle spins beneath the enemy with runes, a bubbling cauldron-green smoke swirl rises, then a giant purple and green star explosion bursts upward with crackling magic and twinkling sparkles.
elf: Elf archer ultimate 'Forest Star Arrows': a rain of glowing green leaf-shaped energy arrows falls from above onto the enemy in a wide cone, each impact blooms with leaves and green light, ending in a big swirling leaf tornado burst.
ninja: Ninja ultimate 'Hundred Shadow Cuts': the enemy is surrounded by many fast dark blue afterimage slash lines from every direction in quick succession, smoke puffs and shuriken sparks, then a final big X cut flash and a burst of black smoke and leaves.
priest: Priest ultimate 'Miracle of the Lantern': a warm golden lantern of light descends, a large glowing holy cross shape forms over the enemy, radiant beams shine out in all directions and a soft golden shockwave ring with healing sparkles spreads.
lancer: Lancer ultimate 'One Step Pierce': a giant blue spear thrust drives straight through the enemy horizontally with a long glowing spear-shaped energy beam, a cone shockwave blasts out behind it, blue wind rings and sparks.
dwarf: Dwarf ultimate 'Mother Lode Smash': a giant glowing orange hammer slams down onto the enemy, the ground cracks with glowing lava-orange fissures, rocks and gem crystals burst up, dust cloud and a heavy shockwave ring.
sage: Sage ultimate 'Guiding Constellation': glowing white-blue constellation lines connect stars around the enemy, the star map spins, then all stars collapse into the center with a brilliant arcane flash and a ring of runes.
paladin: Paladin ultimate 'Golden Rampart': a giant translucent golden shield wall with a cross emblem slams down onto the enemy, holy light bursts from its edges, golden shockwave and shining shield-shaped sparkles.
monk: Martial artist ultimate 'Hundred Fists': dozens of rapid orange glowing fist impacts hit the enemy in a flurry with impact rings, then one giant fist-shaped energy punch blasts through with a huge orange shockwave and flying dust.
dancer: Dancer ultimate 'Blade Waltz': swirling pink and gold ribbon-like blade trails spin around the enemy in a circle dance, rose petals and sparkles fly, then the ribbons tighten into a bright pink burst.
bard: Bard ultimate 'Hero's Ballad': big glowing golden music notes and sound wave rings pulse out around the enemy in rhythm, a giant shining note slams down, colorful sparkles and star bursts.
alchemist: Alchemist ultimate 'Almost-Success Explosion': several green and orange potion flasks fly in and shatter on the enemy, chain reaction bubbling explosions of green, orange and purple smoke, then one big colorful blast with glass shards and bubbles.
pirate: Pirate ultimate 'Cannon Broadside': several cannonballs streak in and hit the enemy with big orange fiery explosions and black smoke, then a splash of a giant water wave crashes over, coins sparkle.
frost: Frost mage ultimate 'Absolute Zero': cold blue mist gathers, then giant ice crystal spikes erupt around the enemy and freeze it in a large ice block, the ice shatters with sparkling shards and a frosty snowflake burst.
tamer: Beast tamer ultimate 'Beast Friends Rush': spirit animal shapes (a glowing cat, crow and wolf in light blue spirit light) dash at the enemy one after another, paw-print impacts, then a big icy blue spirit burst with feathers.
math: Math teacher ultimate 'Blackboard Proof': glowing chalk-white math formulas and equations write themselves in the air around the enemy, they converge into a giant shining QED symbol that slams down with a bright white-gold flash and chalk dust.
dknight: Dark knight ultimate 'Blood Moon Cleave': a huge blood-red full moon rises behind, then three giant crimson crescent greatsword slashes rip across the enemy one after another, the moon shatters into red shards, black-purple flames explode upward and crimson lightning crackles.
mathboy: Student strategist ultimate 'One-Line Solution Strike': a glowing golden compass draws a perfect circle around the enemy, lines of glowing blue solution text stack up, then a bright ruler-shaped beam strikes down with a geometric flash.
mathgirl: Student strategist ultimate 'Proof to the End': glowing triangle-ruler shapes and blue-pink solution lines spiral around the enemy and stack into a tower, then collapse into a big triangular light burst with sparkles.
mechanic: Mechanic ultimate 'Gear Storm': many spinning metal gears and bolts fly around the enemy in a whirlwind, sparks and steam, then a giant mechanical piston slams down with an electric orange blast.
hacker: Hacker ultimate 'System Hack': green digital code rain and glitch squares cover the enemy, a holographic lock icon cracks open, then a big green glitch explosion with pixel fragments and scanlines.
dragoon: Dragon knight ultimate 'Dragon Breath': a huge spectral red dragon head of fire appears and breathes a massive flame stream onto the enemy, a big fire explosion with embers and a fiery shockwave.
spellblade: Spell blade ultimate 'Thunder Spellblade': a purple magic circle spins above, a giant lightning bolt strikes into a sword slash across the enemy, purple and electric blue lightning arcs crackle and burst.
bone: Necromancer ultimate 'Skeleton Parade': bony hands and skulls with glowing green eyes rise from a dark purple portal under the enemy and grab it, then a burst of green ghost fire and bone fragments.
crossbow: Crossbow hunter ultimate 'Three Breaths, One Shot': a red targeting reticle locks onto the enemy, then a single super fast glowing bolt pierces through with a long light trail and a big piercing impact burst and wind rings.
abacus: Abacus mage ultimate 'Thousand Bead Abacus': rows of glowing golden abacus beads slide and click around the enemy, numbers flash, then the beads rain down in a sparkling golden burst.
geometry: Geometry mage ultimate 'Perfect Shape': glowing cyan circle, triangle and square shapes rotate and overlap around the enemy forming a magic seal, then the shapes collapse into a brilliant geometric light explosion.
merchant: Merchant ultimate 'Golden Jackpot': a shower of gold coins and gems rains onto the enemy, a giant golden scale tips and slams down, coin burst with sparkles and a golden flash.
drone: Drone pilot ultimate 'Drone Squadron Strike': small drones fly over and drop many glowing orange missiles onto the enemy, a chain of small explosions then one big blast with smoke and sparks.
valkyrie: Valkyrie ultimate 'Heavenly Descent': huge white angel wings of light spread, a golden spear of light dives down from the sky onto the enemy, holy feathers and a radiant golden-white shockwave.
elemental: Elementalist ultimate 'Three Element Ensemble': fire, water and wind spirit orbs circle the enemy and fire beams together, red flame, blue water splash and green wind swirl combine into one big rainbow burst.
astro: Astrologer ultimate 'Re-read Star': a starry night circle opens above the enemy, constellation lines connect, then a giant shining star falls and explodes with purple and gold stardust and twinkles.
